uca_sentences: A bald man wearing sunglasses hid something in his white short sleeves, then turned around and walked inside. The boss at the counter stood up and looked.
The boss at the counter stood and looked in the direction where the man in white short sleeves left.

witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: I saw a man who stole something turn around and hide something. I'm pretty sure he was wearing white short sleeves, but I'm not sure about the upper clothing. The man had a bald head. A person who works in the shop stood up and looked, but I'm not sure about their actions or appearance.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a man who hid something and then turned around. I think a person who works in the shop stood up and looked, but I'm not sure about that.

witness_C.statement: I saw a man who stole something. He turned around and walked inside. I think he was wearing white short sleeves. A person who works in the shop stood up and looked. I'm pretty sure there was a knife as a weapon.
